title: Credo (Hesdin, Missa Benedicta es)

cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0029_3); edited by Christina Cassia, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
